segments.subtask: The robot arm approaches the white plug on the wooden table.
The robot arm grasps the white plug on the wooden table.
The robot arm lifts the white plug from the wooden table and moves it towards the power strip.
The robot arm positions the white plug over the power strip.
The robot arm inserts the white plug into the power strip.
The robot arm releases the white plug in the power strip and begins to retract.
The robot arm moves away from the power strip and returns to its starting position.
